items.title: What the AI stock crash cost your 401(k) for every $1,000 invested
items.summary: Thursday's AI stock crash cost a basic S&P 500 index fund about a nickel on the dollar, while chip stocks lost nearly a third of their value.

items.title: Bitcoin rebounds after sell-off, and the White House gets crypto broker rules
items.summary: Scott Melker discusses bitcoin (BTC-USD) erasing its losses from a sell-off, Trump Media  (DJT)moves bitcoin, and the SEC crypto broker rules hitting the White House.
